records.question: Which non-financial companies had total liabilities greater than total assets in 2024?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT c.name
FROM company c
JOIN filing f ON c.lei = f.lei
JOIN financial_fact ff ON f.filing_id = ff.filing_id
WHERE c.is_financial = false AND f.fiscal_year = 2024 AND ff.metric = 'total_liabilities' AND ff.value_eur > (
    SELECT value_eur
    FROM financial_fact
    WHERE lei = ff.lei AND fiscal_year = 2024 AND metric = 'total_assets'
)
ORDER BY ff.value_eur DESC;
records.executed_sql: SELECT c.name FROM company AS c JOIN filing AS f ON c.lei = f.lei JOIN financial_fact AS ff ON f.filing_id = ff.filing_id WHERE c.is_financial = FALSE AND f.fiscal_year = 2024 AND ff.metric = 'total_liabilities' AND ff.value_eur > (SELECT value_eur FROM financial_fact WHERE lei = ff.lei AND fiscal_year = 2024 AND metric = 'total_assets') ORDER BY ff.value_eur DESC LIMIT 200
records.reference_sql:
SELECT company_name FROM company_year
WHERE fiscal_year = 2024 AND NOT is_financial AND total_liabilities > total_assets

records.question: ¿Cuál fue el margen neto agregado de las empresas no financieras en 2023?
records.generated_sql:
WITH company_year_data AS (
    SELECT 
        fiscal_year,
        SUM(net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM 
        company_year
    WHERE 
        is_financial = 'f'
        AND fiscal_year = 2023
    GROUP BY 
        fiscal_year
)
SELECT 
    fiscal_year,
    (total_net_profit::numeric / total_revenue) AS net_margin
FROM 
    company_year_data;
records.executed_sql: WITH company_year_data AS (SELECT fiscal_year, SUM(net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM company_year WHERE is_financial = 'f' AND fiscal_year = 2023 GROUP BY fiscal_year) SELECT fiscal_year, (CAST(total_net_profit AS DECIMAL) / total_revenue) AS net_margin FROM company_year_data LIMIT 200
records.reference_sql:
SELECT net_margin FROM year_aggregate_ratios
WHERE fiscal_year = 2023 AND NOT is_financial
